definition: Valid generated receiver setup / setups independently audited
interpretation_limit: Exception name alone is not ground truth

definition: Accepted fresh-object probes / executed probes
interpretation_limit: Search-policy dependent; not test-generation success

definition: Scenarios with selected verified witness / 2
interpretation_limit: Two scenarios are not independent projects

definition: Initial generated candidate passing before any repair / initial candidates
interpretation_limit: Do not substitute retained final-suite pass rate

definition: Tests passing original implementation after repair/filtering
interpretation_limit: Selection after repair makes this unsuitable as first-pass rate

definition: Tests reaching returned-loader initialization / tests attempted
interpretation_limit: Factory invocation alone is insufficient

definition: Union of executed target+nested arcs / union of executed+missing arcs
interpretation_limit: Never substitute module branch coverage

definition: Covered branches / branches in returned loader __init__
interpretation_limit: Report function qualified name

definition: Union of executed lines / union of executed+missing target lines
interpretation_limit: Coverage is not oracle correctness

definition: Killed / 2 for the common predeclared mutant pool
interpretation_limit: NA for inconclusive or no eligible tests; illustrative pilot only

definition: Confirmed bugs detected by original-passing tests
interpretation_limit: Validate fixed and buggy revisions; do not rename mutants as real bugs

definition: Checker diagnostic observations by heuristic category
interpretation_limit: Repeated checks are not independent test failures

definition: Assertions before vs after repair/reduction
interpretation_limit: Passing assertion-free tests can inflate executability

definition: Nodeids whose outcomes vary across repeated clean replays
availability: current one replay only detects some instability
interpretation_limit: Specify replay count; one replay cannot establish stability

definition: Extracted and verified selected identical witness
interpretation_limit: Report separately and retain in all-case results

definition: Actual input/output tokens including initialization and repair
interpretation_limit: Do not call equal per-call limits equal-total-budget

definition: Calls by upstream operation/phase
interpretation_limit: Initialization call total is data-dependent

definition: Calls reaching max_new_tokens
interpretation_limit: A cause to audit when small model produces incomplete code

definition: Model load, setup_total, initialization, generation+repair+coverage, scoring
interpretation_limit: Do not stack AST+probe on top of setup_total

definition: Elapsed whole comparison / whole notebook launcher
interpretation_limit: Keep shared download/bootstrap costs separate

definition: Allocator peak and sampled physical memory
interpretation_limit: Reserved differs from allocated; sampled peak may miss bursts

definition: Physical GPU utilization observations
interpretation_limit: Operational telemetry, not an effectiveness outcome or energy measure

definition: Time/edit count to accept or fix generated fixture/tests
interpretation_limit: No human-effort claim from token savings alone

definition: Stages, arms, tracked init steps, rounds, LLM ended/started, probes/budget, mutants/total
interpretation_limit: Work count is not percent elapsed runtime or an ETA
